# Roles and permissions

<!-- Generated by `go test ./internal/api -run TestRolesDoc -update` in backend/. Do not edit. -->

What each role may do. Every API operation needs one permission; a role is a set of permissions.
The same four roles exist on the organization and on a project. A role on the organization applies to every project; a direct role on a project applies to that project only; the role in a project is the higher of the two.
Permissions of the `organization` level are held only through an organization role, so a person without one (who belongs to the organization only through projects) never holds them. `project` permissions are judged per project with that role. The `account` level is the person's own session and organizations and is held by everybody who belongs to the organization.

## Roles and permissions

| Permission | Level | What it allows | owner | maintainer | member | viewer |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `account.use` | account | Use the session, switch and leave organizations, link sign-in identities | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| `organization.delete` | organization | Delete the organization | yes | | | |
| `organization.domains.manage` | organization | Manage the sign-in domains of the organization | yes | | | |
| `organization.members.read` | organization | List the members of the organization | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| `organization.members.manage` | organization | Change and remove members, manage invitations | yes | yes | | |
| `usage.read` | organization | Read the usage counts against the plan limits | yes | yes | | |
| `project.create` | organization | Create projects | yes | yes | | |
| `project.read` | project | List and read projects | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| `project.update` | project | Change project settings | yes | yes | | |
| `project.delete` | project | Delete a project | yes | | | |
| `project.members.read` | project | List the members of a project | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| `project.members.manage` | project | Add, change and remove project members | yes | yes | | |
| `monitor.read` | project | Read monitors, their statistics and checks | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| `monitor.create` | project | Create monitors | yes | yes | yes | |
| `monitor.update` | project | Change, pause and resume monitors | yes | yes | yes | |
| `monitor.delete` | project | Delete monitors | yes | yes | yes | |
| `incident.read` | project | Read the incidents of a monitor | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| `heartbeat.manage` | project | Regenerate heartbeat tokens | yes | yes | yes | |
| `channel.read` | project | List and read notification channels | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| `channel.manage` | project | Create, change, test and delete notification channels | yes | yes | | |
| `statuspage.read` | organization | Read the status page settings and link | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| `statuspage.manage` | organization | Configure, protect and publish status pages | yes | yes | | |

## Operations

Operations marked `public` need no session. Operations marked `platform admin` are decided by the platform administrator flag, not by an organization role.
